$comment: The closed list of warning codes a server may return on create, one example each. Warnings are returned beside the stored submission and never stored. `keyword_codes` maps the JSON Schema keyword that fails in a kind schema to the code it produces. `duplicate_<member>` is a family: one code per x-unique-by member a kind schema declares (only `slot` today); a kind schema must never declare x-unique-by "key", which would collide with the decoder's duplicate_key.

codes.meaning: kind was absent, null, empty after normalisation or not a string; stored as unknown

example.message: kind is missing, empty or not a string; stored as unknown

codes.meaning: a top-level member the envelope does not know, or a context that was not an object, was moved into payload

example.message: Model is not an envelope member; moved into payload; did you mean model

codes.meaning: payload was absent; it was built from the moved members, or is {}

example.message: payload was absent; built from the members the envelope does not know

codes.meaning: payload, or the reserved payload.moved, was not an object and was wrapped as {"value": ...}

example.message: payload was not an object; wrapped as {"value": ...}

codes.meaning: a member name appeared more than once in an object, or an inferred member replaced an earlier value under a reserved name; the last value is kept

example.message: member 'summary' appears more than once; the last value is kept

codes.meaning: invalid UTF-8 bytes or an escaped lone surrogate in a string or member name were replaced by U+FFFD

example.message: invalid UTF-8 or a lone surrogate escape replaced by U+FFFD

codes.meaning: a string was cut to its byte limit, or context entries beyond the first 32 were moved to payload.context_overflow
a member of the wrong JSON type was encoded as canonical JSON into a string, or a null envelope member was treated as absent

example.message: machine was not a string; encoded as canonical JSON

codes.meaning: schema_version was not a positive integer spelled ^[1-9][0-9]*$ at most 2^53-1; stored as 1

example.message: schema_version is not a positive integer; defaulted to 1

codes.meaning: a member listed in x-recommended is absent
a payload member the kind schema does not list; stored as sent

example.message: 'extra' is not a member the schema knows

codes.meaning: a payload member has a JSON type the kind schema does not allow
a payload member violates minimum, maximum, enum, minLength, minItems, maxItems or maxProperties
a payload string exceeds its x-max-bytes and the schema does not truncate; stored whole
occurred_at did not parse as an RFC 3339 date-time and was kept as context.occurred_at_raw, or a payload string violates its format

example.message: occurred_at is not an RFC 3339 date-time; kept as context.occurred_at_raw

codes.meaning: in an array with x-unique-by, two items share the named member's value
the server ships no schema for this kind; the payload is stored unvalidated

example.message: no schema for kind 'deploy-note'; payload stored unvalidated

codes.meaning: the kind is known but not this schema_version; the payload is stored unvalidated
the key already names a row with a different content_hash; details[0].existing_id is that row

example.message: key 'friction-workstation-a-019250f2' already names submission 41 with different content
